summary: Directional trench crossings and skinned Rebel infantry.
stage: Native embedded Godot, trenches seed 3, trailer-trench-close at 48.2 seconds and trailer-trench-barrage at 7.2 seconds.
rationale: Matched moving footage shows the vertical transition and the updated defenders.

transcode.command: ffmpeg -i comparison.mp4 -map 0:v:0 -map 0:a? -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 26 -b:v 0 -row-mt 1 -threads 2 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a libopus -b:a 128k comparison.webm
transcode.audio: No audio in source or output.
transcode.changes: Format conversion only; no crop, retiming, new capture or generated frames.

evidence_limitations: Foliage partly hides foot placement. The dark, distant character view does not establish close-up animation or equipment quality.
